title: Cove-50 body definition (<builder>.bom.yaml)
description: One annotated definition per builder, next to its script (robot/body/**/<script>.bom.yaml). The agents who own the builder decide everything in it: what the builder generates and from what, which manifest parts it owns and what they are (make / buy, spec, supplier), and how they go together. robot/body/bom/build.py and the checks only read these files, resolve the globs against the selected manifest, add what they can read from files (existence, sha256, solids, volume, mass), and report what is missing. Example and field guide: robot/body/bom/README.md.

definition.description: Short unique id of this definition (used in findings and line origins).

owner.description: Who maintains it: section / session / Idle task.

joints.description: The joints this definition owns and their ranges: the single source of every joint range of the body (owner 2026-11-23). Builders write manifest joints[].range_deg / controls[].range_deg from it, the checks sweep it and the design dashboard moves the CAD over it (robot/body/bom/bom_config.py). Each joint is declared in exactly one definition; the BOM tool reports a joint declared twice, an empty range, a manifest joint without a declaration and a manifest range that differs. Guide: robot/body/bom/README.md 'Configured values'.

match.description: Joint name or list of joint names (exact, no globs): e.g. [R_knee, L_knee] when both sides share the range.

range_deg.description: [lower, upper] joint angle, degrees, manifest sign convention; lower < upper.

doc.description: Why this range: what limits it, which pose library or study it serves.

decision.description: Owner decision or Idle task that set it (e.g. D-15, T-jbe85r).

origin_mm.description: Joint origin in the assembled body frame (mm, manifest frame): a vector for a single-joint match, else {joint: [x, y, z]}. The assembler writes it to manifest joints[].origin_world_mm (bom_config.joint_origin); leave it out where the section manifest's origin is used as built.

axis.description: Joint axis at neutral (unit vector, manifest frame), same form as origin_mm; written to joints[].axis_world_neutral.

config.description: This builder's configured values (dimensions, clearances, counts, thresholds, choices): the single source for the builder that uses them, the checks and the dashboard (robot/body/bom/bom_config.py value(definition, NAME)). One key per value; the script reads it instead of a constant.

value.description: The value: number, string, boolean, list or mapping.

unit.description: Unit of the value (mm, deg, g, N, -).

doc.description: What the value sets and why it has this value.

decision.description: Owner decision or Idle task that set it.

defects.description: Open defects of this builder's parts (no scripted STEP, a file reference that resolves nowhere, ...): what is wrong and what fixing it takes.

study.description: Dashboard study metadata (robot/body/bom/publish_body.py): the design-dashboard record of this study is generated from it, the selected manifest, the definitions and the rebuild outputs. Declared once per study_id over all definitions.

study_id.description: Stable content name of the variant (no round, version or date: Git holds versions).

summary.description: One short finding or trade-off, shown first.

version_note.description: What this version changes, in words; the version itself is the commit of the record's sources.

manifest.description: Body manifest the study shows; default robot/design.json body_manifest (the selected body).

scope.description: Which parts the study's part view lists (default: every manifest part). Parts outside stay in the CAD scene as context.

definitions.description: Definition ids whose parts and assembly steps the study owns.

statements.description: Owner statements and decisions this version rests on.

source.description: Idle task / memory id or file.

evidence.description: Evidence links: repository files (registered as assets) or URLs.

renders.description: Images shown with the study (registered as image assets); the first is the study picture.

cad.description: Display options of the CAD view (viewer settings only).

observation.description: What the study shows, in words (shown before the generated counts).

measurements.description: Hand-stated measurements with units and their source report (shown before the generated check summary).

compose.description: This builder's edits of a body manifest that another generator composes (robot/body/bom/compose.py): the composing script calls compose.apply(stage, manifest), which applies every entry declared `into` that stage, ordered by `after`. Adding a section's edit is a new entry here, never an edit of the composing script.

takes.description: parts: function(parts list) -> new parts list; manifest: function(manifest dict) -> log lines (edits it in place).

after.description: compose ids applied before this one (any definition).

needs.description: generator ids whose outputs the function reads: they run before the composing generator.

names.description: Part name, glob, or list of them (fnmatch, case-sensitive) against the manifest's part names.

command.description: Exact argv, run from the repository root.

rebuild.description: false: a section builder whose outputs the body rebuild links read-only instead of rerunning.

in_place_edits.description: Files written by another generator that it rewrites.

writes_into.description: Folders of another (read-only) generator's outputs that it rewrites; the rebuild copies them writable.

manifest_out.description: The body manifest it writes, if any.

after.description: Generator ids that must run first when the files alone do not order them (several writers of one file).

presentation.description: Presentation output only (renders, figures): never a rebuild input; with rebuild false it is not linked into the rebuild copy.

composes.description: The composition stage this generator applies (robot/body/bom/compose.py apply(stage, manifest)): every definition's `compose` entry into this stage is applied by it, and the generators those entries `need` run before it.

report_files.description: Report files it reads only to merge its own section back into (e.g. a shared report.json): written by it, but not inputs of its result, so a section another generator rewrites (timings) does not make it rerun (robot/body/bom/make.py).

spec.description: The bought item as the agent declares it (standard hardware: kind, thread, nominal length, head standard; sleeves: outer x inner x length).

supplier.description: From a repo source (named in notes), else 'unknown'. Never guessed.

kind.description: printed: an FDM part; purchased: bought as is; hardware: standard hardware; included: comes with another bought part; made: cut / bent / made by hand.

line.description: BOM line id. The same id in several entries or files is one line: its quantities add, and name / make_buy / spec / supplier must agree.

quantity.description: Expected number of matched manifest parts (the check compares it with the match count).

generator.description: Generator id that writes these parts (default: the file's only generator).

contains.description: Bought items inside each matched CAD part (e.g. the steel sleeves of a <part>_steel_sleeves STEP), per matched part.

part.description: Only for this one matched part (default: every matched part).

section.description: Robot section the part belongs to (run.py --section selects by it; checks/data/sections.json is retired).

process.description: Print setup (phase 2: replaces part_settings.json process): printer, material, nozzle_mm, layer_height_mm, up, ... keys of checks/data/printers.json / materials.json.

joined_to.description: Parts this one is joined to without a screw (co-printed, bonded, pressed), as the connectivity check's `joined` edge.

how.description: co_printed | bonded | pressed | other, with a short note if needed

after.description: Subassemblies built before this one (present at its start).

plan.description: What robot/body/checks/assembly_seed.py propose drafts missing steps from: links (owning links whose parts belong here), include / exclude (globs), roles, exclude_roles, last_roles (default body_shell), mirror_of (a subassembly on the other side).

id.description: Unique over all definitions, e.g. right_leg:hip-08.

with.description: Hardware and parts without geometry that go in with the step (not measured).

after.description: Step ids that come before it (any definition); none = at the start of its subassembly.

status.description: designer: the owner's order; seeded: a draft (from assembly_seed.py) not yet reviewed. Check support is measured, not stored.

path.description: Repository path (artifacts/, robot/, ...) registered as a data or image asset of the record.
